audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart was inverted against its own whys and against the packet. It gave Mundo Level 1 (whys[0]: 'Rumble out-ranges you at 1'), gave Rumble Level 3 and Levels 4-5 (whys[2]/[3]: 'you out-sustain his poke', 'your Q spam and W tank his damage'), gave Mundo Level 6 (whys[4]: 'The Equalizer flips the trade'), and gave Rumble both item stages (whys[5]/[6]: your items out-value him).
audit.why: Every row was the opposite of the sentence attached to it. The packet levelChart reads Rumble, Rumble, Mundo, Mundo, Rumble, Mundo, Mundo, which matches the whys and the 56.77% Emerald+ win rate.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-2 Rumble, Level 3 and Levels 4-5 Dr. Mundo, Level 6 Rumble (The Equalizer), First item and 2+ items Dr. Mundo. Submitted as one atomic chart group across content win[] and full phases[].side/.rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Mundo's spike ('press R mid-fight and regen half your HP') when it is Rumble's — The Equalizer is the single biggest swing in the lane, and its cooldown was never given.
audit.why: Rumble R 130/105/80, 1750 range, creates terrain. Maximum Dosage is a flat 120s that heals off missing health (mirror point 3) — it answers the ult but does not own the level.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now states the 130s rank-1 Equalizer and that Flash is held for the wall, not the damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why claimed 'your passive shrugs the first CC'. Rumble has no immobilizing effect at all — Electro Harpoon and The Equalizer are slows — so the canister passive is never popped by him in lane. Also, the decisive terrain interaction (his wall cutting a dashless Mundo's retreat) was absent, and Heart Zapper's heal condition was never stated.
audit.why: Riot text: Rumble E and R slow, W shields and speeds him (the kit file's 'knockup'/'terrain' flags on W are tooltip-parsing misfires — the description grants only shield and move speed). Mundo W heals only if the recast burst hits, 325 range. Mundo Q hits the first enemy and scales off their current health, 975 range, 4s flat.
audit.corrected: Passive claim replaced with the Bonesaw range/cooldown/current-health fact; Heart Zapper's 325-range recast condition stated; The Equalizer named as terrain that cuts a dashless retreat.

edits.before: Full kit online and your passive shrugs the first CC. Cleaver poke plus E-empowered swats start the grind; never brawl while Scrap Shield is up.
edits.after: Full kit online. Infected Bonesaw is 975 range on a 4s cooldown and hits hardest at his full health — chip him whenever Flamespitter is spent.

edits.before: Q ranks make the cleaver chunk real HP and your passive regen ramps. Rumble must kill you through the sustain or watch you out-scale — most can't.
edits.after: Heart Zapper only heals if the recast burst hits — stay inside its 325 range or you eat the damage for nothing. Do that and you out-sustain his poke.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage online — dives and all-ins flip when you press R mid-fight and regen half your HP. Force Rumble to commit, then out-last the commit.
edits.after: The Equalizer lands at 6 and cuts your retreat — a 130s ult at rank 1. Maximum Dosage answers it, but hold Flash for the wall, not the damage.

edits.before: At 6 his R Equalizer zones your regen and spikes his burst, flipping the trade.
edits.after: At 6 The Equalizer walls your retreat and zones your regen, flipping it.

edits.before: Rumble's R Equalizer flips it briefly — the fire line zones your regen, chunks you through W, and combos with his jungler; his Flamespitter overheat also spikes his burst right as his ult lands.
edits.after: The Equalizer flips it at 6: the fire line is terrain that cuts your retreat, and you have no dash — hold Flash for the wall, not the damage. His Flamespitter overheat spikes as the ult lands.

edits.before: Save Equalizer for your R engage to zone your sustain
edits.after: Save The Equalizer to cut your retreat, not to poke

edits.before: That spell is what punishes you — only step up once it’s down or baited.
edits.after: Flamespitter is 8s at rank 3 — step up only once the cone is spent.

edits.before: Save your defensive tool for survival and spacing.
edits.after: Flash saves you from his wall, not from his poke.

notes: Mirror rumble__drmundo already existed and was reused: Bonesaw current-health scaling, Heart Zapper's 325-range recast condition, Maximum Dosage flat 120s, and the fact that Rumble has no immobilizing effect. Both directions now agree that Levels 3 through 5 are Mundo's and Level 6 is Rumble's. suspectNames flagged 'Save Equalizer' — CONFIRMED wrong, the ability is The Equalizer, fixed. Kit-flag misfire recorded: rumble.json puts 'knockup' and 'terrain' on Scrap Shield (W), but Riot's own description grants only a shield and a burst of speed — trusted the description and did not write any knockup interaction. focus.text and the whole breakdown.cooldowns block track Scrap Shield (6s) as the matchup-defining spell, which is wrong in spirit — Flamespitter and The Equalizer decide this lane, not a 6s shield — but those fields are dominated by templated text and were left alone rather than half-rewritten.
